fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

min_standing_note.value: Must be nominated by home partner university in good/competitive academic standing (Smith Commerce notes partner selection; Queen's uses a 4.3 grading scale).
min_standing_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Queen′s University - Arts and Science Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=9
min_standing_note.notes: Home university nomination & academic standing noted on https://www.queensu.ca/international/incoming-exchange.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel agreement_scope_raw is 'BUS, Law, arts&science' (for UG level); maps unambiguously to BUS for Business while arts&science spans HUSS & SSE and Queen's Law is noted in scope despite UG agreement level.

min_gpa_host.notes: Queen's incoming exchange relies on partner university nomination benchmarks (note: the 2.7/2.8 cGPA figures on queensu.ca/international/bilateral-exchange-program govern outgoing Queen's students).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-English-medium applicants must submit IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band <6.0), TOEFL iBT/Home Edition 88 (min 20 in Writing, Speaking, Reading, and Listening; code 0949), Duolingo 120, CAEL 70, PTE 60, or Cambridge 175 (Smith #page=2 also lists TOEFL PBT 580). Exempt with IB diploma (excl. SL English B alone) or >=3 years residency in an English-primary country or full-time study in an English-medium institution. RHET 1020 waiver not stated.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: Confirmed on Smith Commerce 2026-27 Fact Sheet (data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Smith Commerce Undergraduate Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=2).

host_language_requirement.value: English proficiency required unless exempt via 3+ years English-medium instruction.

available_terms.notes: AUC Spring corresponds to Queen's Winter term (January–April).

fall_term_dates.value: 2026-09-08 to 2026-12-23 (Mandatory orientation Sep 4; classes Sep 8–Dec 8; exams Dec 10–23, 2026)
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Queen′s University - Arts and Science Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=4

spring_term_dates.value: 2027-01-15 to 2027-04-23 (Winter term: classes Jan 15–Apr 5; exams Apr 9–23, 2027; orientation Jan 2027)
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Queen′s University - Arts and Science Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=4

tuition_model.notes: Incoming bilateral exchange students pay regular tuition to their home university and do not pay tuition fees to Queen's.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Smith Commerce Undergraduate Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=4
est_monthly_living_local.notes: Sum of Smith Commerce 2026-2027 monthly Kingston estimates: off-campus housing incl. utilities CAD $720–$1,380 + food $450 + phone $35–$65 + misc >=$355 = CAD $1,560–$2,250+/month (local Kingston Transit pass included with student card).

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Smith Commerce Undergraduate Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=4
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month midpoint estimate: 1,905 CAD/month * 5 months = 9,525 CAD * 0.701358 USD/CAD = 6,680.44 USD (ECB 2026-11-13 cross rate 1 EUR = 1.5758 CAD and 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD -> 1 CAD = 0.701358 USD, collected 2026-11-15: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory automatic enrollment in University Health Insurance Plan (UHIP) for international/exchange students (~CAD $264/1 term or CAD $528/2 terms per 2026-27 factsheets; transcripts held if UHIP balance owed). Student card includes Kingston Transit.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Smith Commerce Undergraduate Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=4
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Transcript hold rule on Arts & Science Fact Sheet #page=10; UHIP mandatory confirmation on https://www.queensu.ca/international/incoming-exchange/costs.

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Queen′s University - Arts and Science Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=12
housing_availability.notes: Both 2026-2027 Arts & Science (#page=12) and Smith Commerce (#page=4) fact sheets state verbatim: 'On-campus residence is not available.'

housing_notes.value: Off-campus rentals only (est. CAD $720–$1,380/month incl. utilities); supported by Queen's Off-Campus Living Advisor (OCLA) and Queen's University International Centre (QUIC).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Queen′s University - Arts and Science Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=13
housing_notes.notes: Monthly rental estimate from Smith Commerce Fact Sheet #page=4.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Single-semester exchange (<6 months) can enter as a visitor (TRV or eTA, no Canadian Study Permit required); stays of 6 months or more (full-year) require a Canadian Study Permit.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Queen′s University - Arts and Science Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=13
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Same rule stated on Smith Commerce Fact Sheet #page=4.

credit_system_and_load.value: Queen's credit units (3.0 units = 1 one-term course; 6.0 units = full-year course). Standard full-time load: 12.0–15.0 units (4–5 courses) per semester; 4.3 GPA grading scale.
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Queen′s University - Arts and Science Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=8

course_restrictions_note.value: Arts & Science excludes History (300-level+) and Political Studies (300-level+) and limits high-demand subjects (e.g., Economics, Psychology, Sociology).
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Queen′s University - Arts and Science Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=9
course_restrictions_note.notes: For Smith Commerce exchange (`data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Smith Commerce Undergraduate Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=3`), students must take the majority of courses in Smith School of Business (pre-requisites apply; >=6 Business/Economics foundation courses recommended on #page=2).

city_tier.notes: Smith Commerce 2026-27 Fact Sheet describes Kingston as a "small size city"; left unknown rather than guessing college_town vs mid_size_city.

campus_type.notes: Arts & Science Fact Sheet describes a campus-based university ~10-minute walk from downtown Kingston; left unknown rather than assuming urban vs suburban.

international_support_services.value: International Programs Office (IPO), Queen's University International Centre (QUIC), Off-Campus Living Advisor (OCLA), Orientation, and free transcript dispatch (if account clear).
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Queen′s University - Arts and Science Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=13

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall / Full Year: nomination April 1, application April 30. Winter: early nomination April 1 / final nomination September 1, final application September 30 (fixed annual dates).
nomination_deadlines.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Queens University/2026-2027/Queen′s University - Arts and Science Exchange Fact Sheet.pdf#page=4
nomination_deadlines.notes: Same deadlines confirmed on Smith Commerce Fact Sheet #page=2.
